method: Continuous conservative individual bounding envelopes Y0..378; wood/cargo Z0..3; front and tightened screw/washer assembly vertically aligned. Nominal passage intersections at0/1.5/3; analytical shaft+hole and washer coverage throughout adjustment incl0.5 horizontal.
assembly_sequence: Fit and adjust FGVTN rails/box first, using verified manufacturer jig
Clamp front with2mm joint and reference alignment
Mark pilot positions through clearance holes; drill with depth stop according to actual board/screw supplier
Install four4x30 pan-head screws and wide washers per front, tighten evenly
If changing box height: loosen front screws, realign front, retighten; do not force adjustment while clamped
Check retention and loaded travel on real material
not_validated: FGVTN exact clip envelope, fasteners and rear cuts
Actual board material/retention, pilot drilling and tightening torque
As-built tolerance stack for1/1.6mm cargo clearance
